sample: A sample judgment for the worked example, filled in by hand to show what a learn verdict looks like and what learn record does with it. It is one reading of the packet, not a model run, and another judge may answer differently. hyperspec ignores this field.

edits.why: persona.will_not_say already rules out a claim about what most managers do, and the factory still wrote one, so the rule needs saying more plainly
a typo; no block of the spec governs spelling
the paragraph retells the voice memo segment marked aside, which no spine claim cites; the marking held it back and the factory used it anyway

no golden and no style rule shows advice given flat, so the factory hedged it (can be helpful, may, might); a golden that states a habit as an instruction, or a rule against hedged advice, would have prevented it
the same hedge in one sentence: this writer gives instructions, and nothing in the scope says so
